$comment: Locked Keep the Line chrome. No STEADI, stand counts, or clinical labels.

howto.title: Keep the Line
howto.body: Today’s move is chair sit-to-stand. The camera tracks your body. Fruit appears on your knees — hold good form to slice hits; knees in or hands pushing off turn fruit into bombs (misses). Stop is always on screen. Coach talks when you finish.

ready.title: Before you start
ready.body: Sturdy chair behind you? Feeling OK to start?

frame.title: We need to see you
frame.body: Stand so your hips, knees, and feet are in the outline.

live.prompt: Slice the fruit — sit to stand
live.how: Watermelon on knees = good form. Bombs = knees in or hands pushing off.
live.step_back: Step back so we can see your knees — then keep playing.
